title: Comfort Club Price Lock and the First-System Rate of a Reinstated Term
content:
On a reinstated term of the Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements, the agreement's locked rate shapes the first-system rate its dues are billed at.

## Price lock rule
| Agreement's locked rate | Months since first enrolled (whole calendar months from the enrolled date to the date of handling) | First-system rate |
|---|---|---|
| Below the tier's current first-system annual rate | 60 or more (the lock tenure months) | the locked rate |
| Below the tier's current first-system annual rate | fewer than 60 | the average of the locked rate and the current rate, rounded to the cent half up |
| Not below the current rate | any | not changed by this rule |

## Worked figures (hypothetical Comfort Club Gold agreement, current first-system annual rate 249.00)
- Locked rate 239.00, enrolled 72 months ago: first-system rate 239.00.
- Locked rate 239.00, enrolled 40 months ago: the average of 239.00 and 249.00, which is 244.00.
- Locked rate 230.15, enrolled 40 months ago: the average is 239.575, rounded half up to 239.58.
- Locked rate 249.00 (equal to the current rate): not below it, so this rule does not change the rate.

## Boundary
Exactly 60 whole months since first enrolled takes the locked rate itself.
